a: A pod is the smallest deployable unit and can hold one or more containers.
A Deployment manages replica Pods and rolling updates.
A Service gives a stable virtual IP / DNS name to pods.
Ingress routes external HTTP(S) to Services.
Secrets store sensitive data; still encrypt etcd and limit access.
Liveness probes restart containers that are stuck.
Readiness probes remove unready pods from Service traffic.
Horizontal Pod Autoscaler scales replicas by metrics.
Namespaces partition cluster objects for teams and environments.
